family_status: CONFIRMATORY - preregistered under the PLAN_stocks_v5.md Section 1.1 shadow-effect front door: the raw effect (sector vol-LEVEL sorting, +53.14% raw, PF 2.582, MDD 34.1%, concentration fail) was already observed in a V4 control arm (inventory shadow record SFV4-A4-H1-C, realized as the level-sort control of the V4 semivariance family). That raw number is NOT evidence and NOT a target. This confirmatory status will be recorded in the family verdict and in the denominator: the family's V5 cells count as confirmatory tests of an already-observed raw effect, never as exploratory discoveries.
mechanism question: Is the vol-level premium tradable when risk-managed? Precisely: does a cross-sectional long-low/short-high realized-volatility-LEVEL book across the frozen 11 sector ETFs - scaled by ONE ex-ante, fixed-parameter volatility-targeting overlay - pass the FULL Stage-A gate set with NO relaxation (after-cost expectancy > 0, PF >= 1.10, >= 2/3 folds positive, MDD <= 15% per fold, largest positive-fold share <= 50%, ETF positive-PnL share <= 35%, turnover ceiling 6.0, stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.00, meaningful drop-one survival, risk-matched excess positive in >= 2/3 folds, overall incremental alpha > 0, neighbour support, non-firing control)? The V4 measurement established only that raw level-sorting PnL exists while FAILING the risk and concentration gates (MDD 34.1%, concentration fail); whether the effect survives risk management is a new, open, preregistered question. EX ANTE OVERLAY PREREGISTRATION (chosen before any V5 data is scored; the alternatives vol targeting / beta hedge / gross clamp were considered at design time and VOL TARGETING is declared THE single primary overlay - the other two are not proposed in any arm of this family and may not be substituted ex post): the overlay is c_t = min(1.0, sigma_star / sigma_book_ann(t)) with fixed parameters (i) sigma_star = 0.10 (10% annualized, the conventional institutional risk budget, declared as a single value with no search over alternatives), (ii) sigma_book_ann(t) = sqrt(252 x mean(r_book(u)^2, u in t-62..t)) where r_book is the daily return of the UNSCALED anchor book (population convention, no demeaning - the same fixed realized-vol convention used for the per-sector features), (iii) banding: c_t is rounded DOWN to the nearest 0.10 (c_t := floor(10 x c_t)/10, never upward - conservative direction, turnover control), (iv) final weights = c_t x base weights; gross = c_t <= 1.0; the book NEVER leverages; the scaler is recomputed only at decision slots and weights are static between slots. Rationale, documented ex ante: 10% is below the long-run realized volatility of a gross-1.0 sector spread book, so the overlay binds exactly in the high-volatility states that produced the V4 control's MDD/concentration failure, and it de-risks (never re-levers) the book. The inventory's sanctioned exception applies verbatim: the vol-target overlay lives ONLY inside this Section 1.1 front-door family; no trend, SMA or defensive-rotation input exists anywhere; a vol-targeted defensive rotation as a STANDALONE family remains forbidden and is not proposed. LEVEL-AXIS DOCUMENTATION (disclosed, not hidden): the anchor lives ON the realized-vol LEVEL axis by preregistration - this is the sanctioned Section 1.1 re-entry, not a novelty claim. Three ancestry facts are part of the preregistration: (a) the V4 vol-level control arm is a MEASURED ANCESTOR WITH RAW PNL (+53.14% raw); its relation to this family is explicit - same ranking axis, new question (tradability under the declared overlay), no inversion, no rescue of the semivariance-SHAPE family, which stays closed; nothing here reprices downside/total variance; (b) A7-N will measure the rank correlation between this anchor's feature/rank series and the V4 semivariance-SHAPE anchor (SFV4-A4-H1-A downside/total-variance feature) and the eligibility gate is |rho| <= 0.20; (c) A7-N will separately measure and REPORT (documentation of ancestry, not a pass/fail threshold) the rank correlation between this anchor and the V4 vol-level control ranks, which is expected to be high BY CONSTRUCTION and is disclosed as ancestry. The mechanism claim is not 'the level sort exists' (known, raw, untradable) but 'the preregistered overlay converts a known raw shadow effect into a gate-passing, after-cost, risk-matched tradable strategy'.
falsifiable prediction: Directional and specific. The vol-target-scaled level-sort book (long the 3 sectors with the lowest 63-session realized-vol level, short the 3 highest, c_t-scaled) has: (1) strictly positive after-cost expectancy at 10 bps/side; (2) position PF >= 1.10; (3) at least 2 of 3 chronological folds positive; (4) max fold MDD <= 15% - NOT NEGOTIABLE, the exact gate the V4 control failed at 34.1%; (5) largest positive-fold share <= 50% and ETF positive-PnL share <= 35% - the concentration gates the V4 control failed; (6) risk-matched excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds and overall incremental alpha > 0 versus the frozen risk-matched SPY context; (7) turnover inside the frozen 6.0 two-way/yr ceiling; (8) stress PnL > 0 and stress PF >= 1.00 at 20 bps/side; (9) the 21-session neighbour carries the same sign with positive expectancy; (10) the one-quarter-stale vol-level control does NOT reproduce the spread: control expectancy <= 0 AND |control incremental alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor incremental alpha| AND control incremental alpha <= anchor incremental alpha. The prediction is falsified if ANY gate fails - in particular if MDD > 15% in any fold, if a concentration gate fails again, if overall incremental alpha <= 0, or if the stale-rank control matches or outperforms the anchor - with no overlay re-selection, no sigma_star change, no band change, no window, cadence or universe rescue permitted afterwards.
literature: Ang, A., Hodrick, R. J., Xing, Y., & Zhang, X. (2006). The Cross-Section of Volatility and Expected Returns. Journal of Finance, 61(1), 259-299 - the volatility-LEVEL cross-section: high-vol assets earn lower subsequent returns. This is the level-axis literature ANCHOR for the sign; per Section 1.1 the axis itself is documented ancestry (a V4 control-arm observation), not a new discovery claim.

Blitz, D., & van Vliet, P. (2007). The Volatility Effect: Lower Risk Without Lower Return. Journal of Empirical Finance, 14(1), 1-23 - low-volatility portfolios (including sector/industry-level evidence) outperform with LOWER risk, which is the empirical basis for believing a low-minus-high vol spread book can be held inside an institutional risk budget at all.

Baker, M., Bradley, B., & Wurgler, J. (2011). Benchmarks as Limits to Arbitrage: Understanding the Low-Volatility Anomaly. Financial Analysts Journal, 67(1), 40-54 - the anomaly exists because leverage- and benchmark-constrained investors overweight high-vol assets; this motivates the overlay as part of the MECHANISM (releasing the constraint that makes raw low-vol exposure inefficient) rather than a cosmetic risk patch.

Moreira, A., & Muir, T. (2017). Volatility-Managed Portfolios. Journal of Finance, 72(4), 1611-1644 - scaling exposure by recent realized volatility improves risk-adjusted performance; the direct literature for the EX ANTE choice of a realized-vol-target scaling overlay (scaling, not market timing, no trend input).

NO SEC fields are read anywhere in this family; no fusion/adopted source, no FRED/ALFRED, no FINRA, no Alpha Vantage, no ECB/BIS (any arm reading one fails closed).

PIT observable with availability semanti.window_discipline: S0 2018-04-04..2025-07-31 only (1842 SPY sessions); the 63-session realized-vol window at the first S0 decision is filled from the authorized pre-S0 runway (2010-01-04..2018-04-03); no scored computation reads any session after 2025-07-31; S1 rows never read (SEALED_UNTOUCHED).

universe/warmup/clock/holding/fills.universe: the 11 sector ETFs of the frozen 12-ETF cohort ranked at each decision; SPY never traded. Rank eligibility is an availability rule: a sector enters the rank set from the first decision at which it has >= 63 sessions of its own adjusted-close history (XLC, inception 2018-06-19, enters ~2018-09; before that the rank set is 10 sectors and XLC is held FLAT - availability, not selection).
universe/warmup/clock/holding/fills.warmup: 63 sessions per sector from the authorized pre-S0 runway, so the first S0 session (2018-04-04) is already a valid decision tick for the 10 sectors with pre-S0 history; the neighbour needs 21 sessions.
universe/warmup/clock/holding/fills.decision_clock: per fold, every 63rd SPY session starting at the fold's first scored session (offsets 0, 63, 126, ...), decision computed on that session's PIT close; ~10 decision slots per fold, ~30 total across S0.
universe/warmup/clock/holding/fills.holding_period: 63 sessions per decision book; the scaler c_t is recomputed ONLY at decision slots; weights static between slots; no intraperiod rebalancing; force-flat at every fold boundary (the final slot of a fold may be truncated).
universe/warmup/clock/holding/fills.fills: next allowed session after the decision session per the frozen fill clock (no same-session fill); costs charged exactly once per fill.
universe/warmup/clock/holding/fills.book_shape: base weights +1/6 per long leg (3 lowest-vol sectors) and -1/6 per short leg (3 highest-vol sectors), all scaled by c_t in [0, 1.0]; gross = c_t <= 1.0; net ~0; cash absorbs residual; >= 6 non-CASH legs at every tick (c_t = 0 is a legitimate state in which the overlay takes the book flat - a risk-management outcome, not a position-count violation; the >= 1 non-CASH leg invariant applies to the underlying book construction).

anchor + neighbour + causal negative con.anchor: SFV5-A5-H2-A, exact rule (no parameter menu): (1) daily adjusted-close returns per eligible sector; (2) at decision session t, sigma_s(t) = sqrt(mean(r_s(u)^2, u in t-62..t)) - the 63-session realized-vol LEVEL, population convention, no demeaning; (3) rank eligible sectors by sigma_s ASCENDING (rank 1 = lowest vol); ties broken by ticker alphabetical ascending; (4) base book: long the 3 lowest-vol sectors (ranks 1-3) at +1/6 each, short the 3 highest-vol sectors (ranks 9-11) at -1/6 each; (5) overlay: c_t = min(1.0, 0.10 / sigma_book_ann(t)) with sigma_book_ann(t) = sqrt(252 x mean(r_book(u)^2, u in t-62..t)) computed on the UNSCALED anchor book's own daily returns through t (PIT-deterministic), banded DOWN to the nearest 0.10; final weights = c_t x base weights; gross = c_t <= 1.0; (6) weights fixed until the next decision slot; fills next allowed session; force-flat at fold boundaries. The 3/3 legs, 63-session feature window, 63-session cadence, sigma_star = 0.10, 0.10-banding, gross cap 1.0 and tie rule are all fixed ex ante with no alternatives offered.
anchor + neighbour + causal negative con.neighbour: SFV5-A5-H2-N, one fixed variant supporting the same mechanism: identical in every element - same 3/3 book, same overlay formula with sigma_star = 0.10 and 0.10-banding computed from the NEIGHBOUR book's own returns - except the per-sector level feature uses 21 sessions: sigma_s'(t) = sqrt(mean(r_s(u)^2, u in t-20..t)). Mechanism-support logic: if a persistent low-vol state premium exists and is overlay-tradable, the shorter-memory level carries the same sign with positive expectancy; disagreement marks the 63-session anchor window-specific and fails the neighbour-support gate. No other variant is proposed.

causal_negative_control.control: SFV5-A5-H2-C, one-quarter-stale vol-level ranks: identical everything - same 3/3 book shape, same cadence, same universe and eligibility, same fills, same overlay formula (sigma_star = 0.10, banded) computed from the CONTROL book's own returns - except the ranks used at decision session t are the anchor's sigma-ranks as of t-63: the control trades the vol state one full holding period old under today's risk management. Distinct from BOTH V4 control arms BY CONSTRUCTION: the V4 vol-level control arm used FRESH ranks and NO overlay; the V4 stale-rank control was participation (dollar-volume), not volatility. This control is the family's OWN falsification surface and no V4 arm substitutes for it.
causal_negative_control.must_not_carry_if_causal_story_true: if the tradable object is compensation for allocating to the CURRENT low-vol state, then ranks one full state-period old misclassify the current state exactly where the state has moved, and the stale book must not earn the spread after the same overlay and costs; if the stale book DOES earn it, the raw +53.14% was never timely state information but slow sector-exposure drift that any old level rank reproduces.
causal_negative_control.preregistered_falsification_rule: the control refutes the mechanism - and the overlay is thereby proven NON-TRANSFORMATIVE - if the control's after-cost expectancy > 0 AND (|control incremental alpha| >= 0.5 x |anchor incremental alpha| per the frozen control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt = 0.5 gate, OR control incremental alpha > anchor incremental alpha, i.e. the control OUTPERFORMS the anchor). A negative-or-nonpositive anchor with a worse control rejects the family per the frozen negative-result rule (a control that outperforms a negative anchor falsifies the mechanism - confirmatory-region families included). No alternate control may be substituted after results are seen.
causal_negative_control.identifiability_preregistration_L7: vol levels are persistent, so stale and fresh ranks correlate by construction; identification exists only where the vol state actually moved within the quarter - which is precisely where the tradability question has content. Preregistered pre-scoring eligibility checks (A9-F, PIT data only, no PnL): (i) measured Spearman correlation between anchor and control rank vectors at the decision slots <= 0.90; (ii) membership divergence: at least 25% of decision slots have at least one differing long/short membership leg between anchor and control. If either fails, the control cannot identify timeliness and the family is INELIGIBLE before any scoring (lesson L7: V4 killed four proposals pre-selection on measured control self-subsumption rho 0.78-0.83). This precondition is declared now so the family dies cheaply if the axis is too persistent to identify, rather than being scored unidentifiably.

incremental-alpha test: Per the frozen benchmark contract: incremental alpha = arm return - risk-matched SPY context, with the SPY context scaled EX ANTE by the arm's frozen risk-match rule: kappa_t = clip(beta_hat_t, 0.0, 2.0), beta_hat_t = trailing 252-session OLS slope of the arm's own daily book returns through t-1 on SPY total-return daily returns (PIT-deterministic; realized volatility never substituted post hoc). Evaluated per fold and overall; gates: risk-matched excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds and overall incremental alpha > 0. Sector beta is plausible because all legs are sector ETFs, so the neutralization step is added: daily OLS r_arm = a + b1*r_SPY + b2*r_EW_sector + eps per fold and over S0, intercepts reported annualized; the anchor must retain positive residual alpha after both-factor removal. LOUD STATEMENT, per lesson L6 and the lessons_register v4 falsification observations: the V4 control's +53.14% raw is sector-exposure and concentration until proven otherwise; raw PnL NEVER overrides failed incremental alpha or a firing control - for this confirmatory family that rule is the whole point of the exercise. All gates fail closed.

base and stress costs.cost_schedule: 10 bps per side per fill (base), 20 bps per side per fill (stress rerun), charged exactly once per fill per the frozen no-double-charge invariant (L2).
base and stress costs.both_reruns_reported: the stress rerun gates (stress PnL > 0, stress PF >= 1.00) apply unrelaxed; risk management that only survives cheap costs is not tradability.

turnover and sample floor.convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (one named convention, ADJ-5, L3), annualized two-way; frozen ceiling 6.0; both raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover and sample floor.expected_turnover: three components: (i) membership churn ~1 leg pair per decision -> 2/3 two-way per decision x ~4.1 decisions/yr ~= 2.7/yr; (ii) overlay band moves: each 0.10 band step changes all six legs by |dc| x gross = 0.10 of two-way; expected |dc| ~ 0.2-0.4 per decision -> ~0.8-1.6/yr; (iii) initial build + 3 fold-boundary force-flat rebuilds (4 x 2.0 over ~7.2 yr) ~= +1.1/yr. Base estimate ~4.6-5.4/yr two-way (point ~5.0, ~83% of the ceiling).
turnover and sample floor.why_inside_ceiling: headroom is thin BY DESIGN and declared ex ante: the overlay trades only in 0.10-banded steps at 63-session cadence on a persistent state, and the down-only banding forbids churn from upward re-levering. A ceiling breach is an accepted falsification surface - risk management that must trade more than 6.0 two-way/yr to hold a 10% budget is itself a tradability failure of the family - and is never a tuning target (no wider bands, no slower cadence, no sigma_star change may be proposed afterwards).
turnover and sample floor.cost_drag: ~50 bps/yr at base, ~100 bps/yr at stress on the point estimate; the gate question is whether the risk-managed spread clears these drags with all other gates intact.
turnover and sample floor.sample_floor: ~10 decision slots per fold (63-session cadence over fold spans of ~607-619 sessions) and ~30 total across S0: the frozen floors (>= 5 decisions/fold, >= 30 total) are met exactly, with zero slack; any voided slot drops the arm below the floor and the arm is scored ineligible rather than re-timed. PF computed over decision-level PnLs under the frozen position-PF convention; the sample is thin but per contract.

drop-one design.drop_one_etf: value_book rerun excluding the single max-contribution symbol by cumulative PnL; the remaining 10 (or 9) sectors are re-ranked from scratch under the identical rule INCLUDING the overlay (book still 3v3, c_t recomputed on the dropped book's own returns); survival = after-drop expectancy > 0. This is the decisive robustness test for this family: the V4 control's measured failure was CONCENTRATION, so the family must demonstrate the risk-managed spread is not carried by one sector pair; the frozen ETF positive-PnL share <= 0.35 gate is enforced ex post as the backstop.
drop-one design.drop_one_fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival = min > 0; the frozen largest-positive-fold share <= 0.5 gate applies as the ex post backstop. Meaningful because a level-sort premium can be a single volatility-regime artifact (e.g. only the 2020 episode), and the claim is a persistent, risk-managed premium.

failure interpretation: A Stage-A reject means the vol-level shadow effect is NOT tradable when risk-managed, and the Section 1.1 question is answered in the negative: (i) if MDD > 15% in any fold or a concentration gate fails, risk management at the preregistered budget does not transform the effect - the overlay is non-transformative by direct measurement; (ii) if the one-quarter-stale control reproduces or outperforms the anchor, the raw +53.14% was never timely state information but timeliness-free exposure form (slow sector drift), and no overlay can create information the rank never had; (iii) if overall incremental alpha <= 0 or risk-matched excess fails, the raw number was SPY/sector beta, exactly the L6/V2/V4 failure mode. In every branch the family is CLOSED: the confirmatory status is recorded in the family verdict and the denominator as a CONFIRMED non-tradable shadow effect (denominator math 18 historical + V5 cells, confirmatory flag carried on this family's rows); no sigma_star re-selection, no overlay substitution (beta hedge / gross clamp are ineligible ex post), no band, window, cadence, universe or fee rescue is eligible, and the V4 control's +53.14% raw remains what it always was - an untradable, concentrated, risk-unmanaged control-arm observation, preserved as ancestry and never promoted to evidence.

source-to-test map.1: Ang-Hodrick-Xing-Zhang (2006) level-axis sign -> implementation: 63-session realized-vol LEVEL, ascending rank, long-low/short-high 3/3 base book (anchor steps 1-4); the axis is documented ancestry from the V4 control arm, not claimed as discovery.
source-to-test map.2: Blitz-van Vliet (2007) low-vol outperformance with lower risk -> implementation: the spread form (not long-only) and the claim that it can sit inside a 10% budget; tested by the MDD <= 15% and concentration gates rather than assumed.
source-to-test map.3: Baker-Bradley-Wurgler (2011) constraint origin of the anomaly -> implementation: the overlay is the constraint-release mechanism, declared ex ante as the single primary overlay (vol targeting, sigma_star = 0.10, banded down-only, gross cap 1.0); no trend/SMA/defensive-rotation input exists.
source-to-test map.4: Moreira-Muir (2017) volatility-managed scaling improves risk-adjusted performance -> implementation: c_t = min(1.0, 0.10/sigma_book_ann(t)) recomputed only at 63-session decision slots, weights static between slots (anchor step 5).
source-to-test map.5: timeliness is the causal ingredient, not the axis -> implementation: the one-quarter-stale rank control (t-63 ranks under the identical overlay) with the preregistered falsification rule (control expectancy > 0 AND (alpha ratio >= 0.5 OR control outperforms) -> mechanism falsified, overlay proven non-transformative); control distinct from both V4 control arms by construction.
source-to-test map.6: ancestry documentation, not concealment -> implementation: A7-N measures |rho| <= 0.20 against the V4 semivariance-SHAPE anchor (eligibility gate) and separately measures and REPORTS the rank correlation against the V4 vol-level control ranks (expected high by construction, disclosed as measured ancestry with raw PnL); the confirmatory flag is carried into the family verdict and the denominator.
source-to-test map.7: survival after costs and concentration -> implementation: 10/20 bps cost-once reruns; ADJ-5 turnover with the banded-overlay arithmetic declared; drop-one ETF and fold reruns against the V4 control's measured failure mode (concentration).
